bhcinema.lock.off: Camera unlocked - fly it, then %s to lock again
bhcinema.lock.needs_freecam: Lock works in freecam - press %s first
bhcinema.settings.title: BeeHouse Cinema Settings
bhcinema.settings.collision.tooltip:
ON: the camera bumps into blocks and walls (Follow and Behind move in front of walls, like third person).
OFF: the camera passes through everything.
bhcinema.settings.hide_crosshair.tooltip: Hide the crosshair and block outline while a camera is on.
bhcinema.settings.voice_listener.tooltip:
Plasmo Voice: where you hear voice chat from while a camera is on.
Character: your character. Cam: the camera, fly up to someone to hear them clearer. Character + Cam: both, each voice as loud as from the closer one.
The server must allow freecam listening, and only sends voices within talking range of your character.
bhcinema.settings.look_smoothing.tooltip: How gently the camera turns, in every mode. 0 = follows exactly.
bhcinema.settings.lens_smoothing.tooltip: How gently zoom (Zoom Modifier + mouse wheel), roll and the framing shift change.
bhcinema.settings.fov_step.tooltip: FOV change per notch of Zoom Modifier (Left Alt) + mouse wheel.
bhcinema.settings.letterbox.tooltip: Black cinema bars above and below the picture. Same as pressing K.
bhcinema.settings.letterbox_ratio.toolti: Shape of the picture between the bars. 2.39 = cinema widescreen, 1.85 = flat.
bhcinema.settings.letterbox_smoothing.to: How long the bars take to slide in and out. 0 = instant.
bhcinema.settings.start_distance.tooltip: How far behind your head the freecam starts, so you can see yourself. Walls in the way bring it closer. 0 = starts at your eyes.
bhcinema.settings.fly_speed.tooltip: Freecam flight speed. In game, hold Speed Modifier (Z) and scroll to change it; plain scroll still changes hotbar slot.
bhcinema.settings.sprint_multiplier.tool: Freecam speed multiplier while holding sprint.
bhcinema.settings.follow_pitch.tooltip:
ON: W/S also climb and dive towards where you look (spectator style).
OFF: W/S stay level like creative flight; Space/Shift go up and down.
bhcinema.settings.move_smoothing.tooltip: How gently the freecam speeds up and slows down. 0 = starts and stops instantly.
bhcinema.settings.roll_speed.tooltip: How fast the freecam rolls while holding Roll Left / Roll Right (arrow keys by default).
bhcinema.settings.mode.tooltip:
What the lock key does in freecam (G switches in game).
Locked: the camera stays where you flew it while you play.
Follow: the camera travels with you at the same distance; hold the middle mouse button to swing it round.
bhcinema.settings.ignore_jumps.tooltip: Locked camera: stays level while you jump. It still follows falls, steps, flying, swimming and climbing.
bhcinema.settings.vertical_smoothing.too: Locked camera: how gently it follows your height when you step up or drop down.
bhcinema.settings.follow_smoothing.toolt: How softly the camera moves after you (Follow, and Locked when it catches up). 0 = rigid.
Locked mode: the camera stays put but keeps turning to look at you, like a tracking shot.
bhcinema.settings.catch_up_distance.tool: Locked mode: walk further than this from the camera and it moves to catch up with you. OFF = the camera never moves.
Follow mode: the camera keeps turning to look at you as it travels.
bhcinema.settings.behind_distance.toolti: How far behind you the camera sits. In game, middle mouse + scroll changes it until the camera is closed.
bhcinema.settings.behind_ignore_jumps.to: Behind camera: stays level while you jump. It still follows falls, steps, flying, swimming and climbing.
bhcinema.settings.behind_vertical_smooth: Behind camera: how gently it follows your height when you step up or drop down.
bhcinema.settings.shift_right.tooltip: Slide the shot sideways as seen on screen. + = right, - = left. Great for over-the-shoulder shots.
bhcinema.settings.shift_up.tooltip: Slide the shot towards the top (+) or bottom (-) of the screen.
bhcinema.settings.shift_forward.tooltip: Push the camera forward (+) or pull it back (-) along where it looks.
bhcinema.settings.framing.hint_live: Locked freecam and Behind only - the shot updates live behind this screen
bhcinema.settings.framing.hint_off: Locked freecam and Behind only - lock freecam (B) or turn on Behind to see it live
bhcinema.settings.auto_hide_hud.tooltip: Hide the whole HUD: hotbar, health, chat, crosshair and HUDs from other mods. It shows for a moment when you change hotbar slot, and while you type in chat or have F3 open. Your first-person hand stays.
bhcinema.settings.auto_hide_only_in_free:
ON: the HUD auto-hides only while freecam (F4) or the Behind camera is on.
OFF: it auto-hides all the time.
bhcinema.settings.hud_show_seconds.toolt: How long the HUD stays visible after you change hotbar slot.
bhcinema.settings.hud_fade_seconds.toolt: How long the HUD takes to fade out once the show time is over. 0 = disappears at once.
bhcinema.settings.reset_tab.tooltip: Put every setting on this tab back to its default.
bhcinema.settings.reset_all.tooltip: Put every BeeHouse Cinema setting back to its default.
bhcinema.settings.reset_all.confirm_mess: Every setting on every tab goes back to its default. Key bindings are not changed.
